root_cause: The canonical publisher and automated recovery existed, but operators had no trusted same-day control-plane path to invoke the canonical publisher and inspect its exact result when the Netlify scheduled endpoint was externally protected with HTTP 403 and direct Supabase SQL access was unavailable.
prevention_rule: Provide a same-day-only GitHub workflow that uses existing GitHub-held Supabase credentials to retrieve the scheduler token without logging it, invoke only the canonical powerhouse-social-publisher, and read back canonical decision state. Never introduce a second provider writer or bypass publication capabilities, uniqueness gates, identity gates, or provider readback.
